summary: Iteration 6: validated the 3 production bug fixes (Deposit whitepage, PublicLink refund optional, PublicLink+Login blank). BUG A (dashboard deposit) and BUG B (public-link -> login -> dashboard) fully pass end-to-end on the preview URL. BUG C is only PARTIALLY fixed: the UI is corrected (button visible + not disabled with empty refund_address, label 'optionnel'), but clicking with an empty refund_address still fails silently because the backend fallback string 'manual-refund' is rejected by IzichangePay ('Adresse de remboursement invalide.' -> HTTP 400). With a valid TRC20 address the flow reaches pay-tracker with QR + address, so BUG C's original 'button invisible' report IS fixed, but the empty-refund path is not truly functional. Backend validation for /api/deposits/crypto with empty refund_address correctly returns 422 (strict, per spec). 6/8 backend pytest pass; the 2 failing tests are the ones asserting empty refund_address should return 200 on /api/links/pay.

critical.issue: With refund_address='' (or missing), backend returns 400 'Adresse de remboursement invalide.' instead of 200. Root cause: server.py::start_link_payment substitutes an empty refund_address with the literal string 'manual-refund' before calling izipay.create_direct_intent, but IzichangePay validates that field as a crypto address and rejects any non-address string. Effect: production users leaving the refund field empty (which the UI now allows) hit the same failure -> silent front-end failure (no toast is rendered). Fix options: (a) require refund_address on the UI for crypto (revert button to disabled), (b) use a real system-owned TRC20 address as fallback, or (c) reuse the merchant's own wallet address as fallback.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking 'Payer maintenant' with an empty refund_address makes the POST fail with 400 but no toast/error is shown to the user. pay-tracker never appears. UX is a silent freeze even though the button is enabled.

action_items: Fix backend fallback in server.py::start_link_payment: 'manual-refund' is rejected by IzichangePay. Substitute a valid TRC20 fallback address (env var IZIPAY_FALLBACK_REFUND_ADDRESS) OR reuse the merchant's crypto_config address OR mark refund_address required on the UI (client-side) with a helpful message. Preferred: env var fallback + surface izipay error via toast in PublicLink CryptoLinkForm's catch block so users are not left staring at a still page.

In /app/frontend/src/pages/PublicLink.js CryptoLinkForm submit(): the catch branch should display an error toast (window.dispatchEvent CustomEvent 'toast' or setError state) when POST /api/links/pay fails, so users see the 'Adresse de remboursement invalide' response instead of a no-op click.

rca of the issue: BUG C backend fix is incomplete: models.py correctly relaxes LinkPayRequest.refund_address to Optional[str]='' and server.py maps empty -> 'manual-refund'. However IzichangePay validates refund_address as an on-chain address and returns an error containing 'address', which server.py maps to 400 'Adresse de remboursement invalide.'. The customer-side UI has removed refund_address from canSubmit, so users can now submit with it empty and hit this failure. Reproduction: curl -s -X POST $API/api/links/pay -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"slug":"NcjVJwMQNLY","asset_code":"USDT.TRC20","full_name":"X","email":"x@x.com","refund_address":"","origin_url":"https://x"}' -> 400. Mitigation: replace fallback with a valid TRC20 address (env-driven), or use link.owner_id merchant's wallet, or restore refund_address as required in the customer UI.
